sources.query:
Write a full research paper about the current best method in my TPI project.

Project and artifact locations:

- TPI project root: `/data4/pengqingsong/DFT/TPI-my.3`
- Current best record: `/data4/pengqingsong/DFT/TPI-my.3/autoresearch/improve-260706-0959/current_best.md`
- Machine-readable current best record: `/data4/pengqingsong/DFT/TPI-my.3/autoresearch/improve-260706-0959/current_best.json`
- Final 8-circuit comparison table: `/data4/pengqingsong/DFT/TPI-my.3/autoresearch/improve-260706-0959/eval8_final_heldout_oldbudget/comparison_final_tc_vs_deeptpi.tsv`
- Raw 8-circuit summary: `/data4/pengqingsong/DFT/TPI-my.3/autoresearch/improve-260706-0959/eval8_final_heldout_oldbudget/summary.tsv`
- Evaluation protocol: `/data4/pengqingsong/DFT/TPI-my.3/configs/eval_protocol_coverage_only.json`
- Main implementation files to inspect if needed:
  - `/data4/pengqingsong/DFT/TPI-my.3/tpi_jepa/plan.py`
  - `/data4/pengqingsong/DFT/TPI-my.3/tpi_jepa/train.py`
  - `/data4/pengqingsong/DFT/TPI-my.3/scripts/run_gmean_sweep.py`
  - `/data4/pengqingsong/DFT/TPI-my.3/autoresearch/improve-260706-0959/run_eval8_final_heldout_parallel.sh`

Paper topic:

World-model-based test point insertion for digital circuits. The current best method is `q_lcb_ensemble_safe`: a Q-value reranking planner with a three-checkpoint ensemble and lower-confidence-bound scoring. The method reranks candidate test points during insertion using:

- greedy cumulative planning,
- Q-value prediction as the action value,
- an ensemble of three Q-rank world-model checkpoints,
- LCB score = ensemble mean minus 0.75 times ensemble standard deviation,
- 96 candidates per insertion step from `heuristic_recall_pool`,
- strict DeepTPI Table-II #TP budgets on 8 circuits.

Important evaluation rule:

- Final TC must be computed as measured local baseline TC + model delta TC.
- DeepTPI Table-II final TC is the external comparison target.
- Do not use `DeepTPI final TC - old delta + model delta` as the model final TC.
- The 8 target circuits must not be described as training data. They are final evaluation circuits.
- In this project, using the 8 circuits for evaluation and result comparison is allowed, but not for training.

Current best aggregate result:

- Method: `q_lcb_ensemble_safe`
- Macro final TC: 90.357%
- Minimum final TC: 74.852%
- Beats DeepTPI: 8/8 circuits
- Worst gap versus DeepTPI: +0.046 percentage points

Current best per-circuit results:

| ID | Circuit | Budget | Local Baseline TC | q_lcb Final TC | DeepTPI TC | Gap |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| D1 | b15_C | 278 | 81.764 | 90.656 | 90.610 | +0.046 |
| D2 | b20_C | 616 | 90.757 | 97.087 | 90.600 | +6.487 |
| D3 | b21_C | 628 | 89.682 | 96.379 | 89.730 | +6.649 |
| D4 | b22_C | 915 | 92.130 | 97.187 | 91.700 | +5.487 |
| D5 | i2c | 34 | 94.900 | 96.907 | 86.110 | +10.797 |
| D6 | max | 94 | 59.796 | 79.916 | 52.650 | +27.266 |
| D7 | b17_C | 994 | 85.623 | 89.869 | 86.840 | +3.029 |
| D8 | mem_ctrl | 1273 | 65.823 | 74.852 | 69.950 | +4.902 |

Required paper framing:

- Present the problem as test point insertion for improving stuck-at fault test coverage.
- Position DeepTPI as the main baseline.
- Explain why simple single-model reranking can be unstable and why uncertainty-aware ensemble scoring helps.
- Emphasize that the proposed method is a planning-time reranker over candidate test points, not a different ATPG backend.
- Include method details, training/evaluation protocol, and ablations/variants from the project when useful.
- Use final TC tables as the primary result tables, not only delta TC.
- Include enough implementation detail to be reproducible: budget, candidates, planner, score field, ensemble checkpoints, LCB alpha, patterns, seed, backend, and paths.
- Do not fabricate results. If a value is not present in the listed files, mark it as not reported.
- If additional analysis code is generated, it must only parse the existing TSV/JSON/CSV artifacts. Do not rerun expensive TPI planning/evaluation and do not retrain models.

Suggested title:

Uncertainty-Aware World-Model Reranking for Test Point Insertion
